clue.text: Call from the US electorate?

definitions.meaning: in bridge a call is a bid, and ... is a bid with ... suit
in 2020 American voters said no to Donald Trump

explanation.walkthrough: A bridge bid doubles as the 2020 American voters' verdict on Donald Trump.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-trump contract is one of the standard bids a bridge player can make, here also read as a rejection of a president.

clue.text: North American province, not a different South American city

indicators.note: different means changed in arrangement, so the letters of not a are rearranged

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is the Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A Canadian province is said not to be a different South American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges NOT A to ONTA.
explanation.definitionFit: Ontario is a Canadian province, home of Toronto and Ottawa.

clue.text: Artist's country escaping Roman god

indicators.note: the country escaping means it leaves the word Roman, taken away

parts.note: Oman is a country in Arabia
Odin is the chief Norse god

explanation.surface: An artist's homeland escapes from a Roman deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman god' reads as one deity, but the country leaves 'Roman' and the god is Norse.
explanation.definitionFit: Auguste Rodin was the French sculptor of The Thinker.

clue.text: When heavenly body drops idle god

parts.note: to moon about is to idle, to pass time aimlessly
Set is the Egyptian god of chaos and storms

explanation.surface: A heavenly being drops a lazy god.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonset is the moment the moon sinks below the horizon.

clue.text: Mysterious flash enveloping trailer

indicators.note: enveloping means the flashy word wraps round the trailer word

parts.note: flash as an adjective means showy
an ad is a trailer, a short advertisement for a film

explanation.surface: A shady film trailer is wrapped in mystery and flashy hype.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shadowy is obscure and hard to make out, so it is mysterious.

clue.text: God dressing priest in short stockings

indicators.note: dressing means the stockings clothe the priest, wrapping round him
short means the stocking word loses its last letter

parts.note: hose is a word for stockings or tights
Eli is the priest in the Bible who brought up Samuel

explanation.surface: A god dresses a priest in short stockings.
explanation.walkthrough: Eli is the Old Testament priest at Shiloh, a standard crossword priest.
explanation.definitionFit: Helios is the Greek personification of the sun, driving its chariot across the sky.

clue.text: Island originally home to climbing marsupial — one of these is as dead as a dodo?

definitions.text: one of these is as dead as a dodo?

indicators.note: being home to means housing something inside, so the reworked island holds the animal
originally hints at the letters being rearranged from their original form
climbing in a down clue means going up, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a roo is a kangaroo, a marsupial

explanation.surface: An island was first the home of a tree-climbing marsupial, now extinct like the dodo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' is an unusual anagram signal, read as the island's letters in some earlier order. The definition plays on the idiom 'dead as a doornail'.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'as dead as a doornail' means completely dead, just as 'dead as a dodo' does.

clue.text: Mass inspiring god, Mars' device?

indicators.note: inspiring is read as breathing in, so the mass takes the god inside

parts.note: a wad is a mass or lump
Rhea is the Titan mother of the Olympian gods

explanation.surface: A mass inspires a god's device, Mars' own.
explanation.walkthrough: Mars is the Roman god of war, so his device is playfully one for war, the explosive tip of a missile.
explanation.definitionFit: A warhead is the explosive part of a missile, a weapon fit for the god of war.

clue.text: Where Morpheus might live to dream, more bunks emptied out

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the letters are rearranged
emptied means the inside of bunks is removed, keeping only its outer letters

explanation.surface: Morpheus lives where you dream, and more bunks have been cleared out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'emptied' reduces BUNKS to BS. Morpheus is the Greek god of dreams, so he would be master of a bedroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A master bedroom is the main bedroom, a fitting home for the master of sleep and dreams.

clue.text: Adonis is boss

definitions.meaning: Adonis, the beautiful youth of Greek myth, stands for any handsome man
a boss is a raised ornamental knob

explanation.walkthrough: Adonis looks like another god in a puzzle full of them, but here he just means a handsome hunk.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is slang for an attractive virile man, and also a projecting knob or nail head, as is a boss on a shield.

clue.text: Retro plain squares under the table, perhaps?

indicators.note: retro means going backwards, so the plain word is read in reverse

parts.note: a llano is a grassy plain in South America
four is two squared, so squares can give fours

explanation.surface: A backward-looking plain design of squares might be found beneath the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retro' reverses LLANO to give ONALL. The definition is a playful example: you might crawl about on all fours under a table.
explanation.definitionFit: Crawling on hands and knees is the posture of someone hunting for something beneath a dining table.

clue.text: God placing 6 and Egyptian equivalent back-to-back behind you

indicators.note: behind says the god pieces follow the word for you

parts.note: U is text-speak for you
Ra is the Egyptian sun god, the equivalent of Helios

indicators.note: back-to-back means the two sun gods sit with their backs meeting, so the second is turned round

parts.note: 6 down is HELIOS, the Greek sun god, so it stands for the sun

explanation.surface: A god is being placed alongside his Egyptian counterpart, back to back, just behind you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-to-back' says the two sun gods meet at their backs, so the Greek one, written as plain sun, faces the other way. Paul reportedly had a ruder clue in mind for this planet's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Uranus is the primordial Greek sky god, father of the Titans.

clue.text: More difficult check reviewed on god

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after the god

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder

indicators.note: reviewed is read as re-viewed, looked at backwards, so the check word is reversed

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain

explanation.surface: A tougher check has been reviewed on a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorny means prickly and tricky, so thornier is comparative: more troublesome or problematic.

clue.text: Female god performs

parts.note: a doe is a female deer or rabbit
Saturn is the Roman god of agriculture

explanation.surface: A goddess is putting on a show.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'Female god' as one goddess; the two words work separately.
explanation.definitionFit: To do a turn is to give a short stage act, as a variety performer does.

clue.text: Close game receives outstanding support, finally

indicators.note: outstanding is read as standing outside, so the rearranged letters stand round the extra one
game in the sense of a lame or gammy leg signals the letters being bent out of shape
finally signals the final letter of the word support

explanation.surface: A close-fought game gets outstanding support at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' rearranges RECEIVES to SECREIVE, and 'outstanding' puts T inside it. 'Close' is the adjective, as in close-mouthed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone close in this sense keeps things to themselves, which is being secretive.

clue.text: Worshipper for whom church in Dudley providing sanctuary

indicators.note: the phrase shelters the answer within its letters, as a refuge does

explanation.surface: A worshipper's local church in the Midlands town of Dudley offers sanctuary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'providing sanctuary' signals the letters lying inside 'church in Dudley'. Dudley is a town in the English West Midlands.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu is a follower of Hinduism, so one who worships its gods.

clue.text: Half-Vulcan box contains head of Prometheus

indicators.note: contains signals the punching word holding the letter inside it

parts.note: to box is to hit, as is to sock

indicators.note: head of signals the opening letter of the Titan's name

explanation.surface: A half-god's boxing bout holds Prometheus by the head.
explanation.walkthrough: Vulcan suggests the Roman smith god, but here it is the planet of Star Trek's Mr Spock, son of a Vulcan father and a human mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Star Trek's science officer is half Vulcan and half human.

clue.text: God lifting couple into drink

indicators.note: lifting in a down clue means raising up, so the whole assembly is read bottom to top
into means the couple goes inside the drink word

parts.note: to sup is to drink
a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: A god raises a couple into a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifting' turns the whole assembly upwards, not just the couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Priapus is the minor Greek fertility god, guardian of gardens.

clue.text: Hard work initially, easier otherwise to maintain order

indicators.note: initially signals only the first letter of the word work
to maintain is to hold, so the rearranged letters hold the order inside
otherwise means arranged differently, signalling a rearrangement of easier

parts.note: the OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: Hard work at the start makes it easier to keep order later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard' is the definition, not part of the work, as the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard in the sense of tiring and tedious is a fair synonym for wearisome.

clue.text: Nemesis rising, for example, over my dead body

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means reading upwards, so the pieces are reversed

parts.note: over my dead body is an emphatic never

explanation.surface: Nemesis rises, defiantly saying it will happen only over someone's dead body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns EGNEVER around. Nemesis, the Greek goddess of retribution, fits the theme but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis was the Greek goddess of retribution, so her name stands for vengeance.

clue.text: Heaven-bound American uncle entertaining European women inspired by Dionysus

indicators.note: heaven-bound in a down clue means going upwards, so the whole is read bottom to top
entertaining means the uncle holds the European inside him

parts.note: Uncle Sam personifies the United States
a Dane is a European from Denmark

explanation.surface: A heaven-bound American uncle entertains a European and some women inspired by Dionysus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heaven-bound' turns the whole, uncle and guest together, upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The maenads were the frenzied female followers of the wine god in Greek myth.

clue.text: Goddess putting second and third of 21 in order?

indicators.note: second picks out the second letter of the 21 down answer

parts.note: 21 down is MAENADS
in order suggests one thing then another, so then is supplied

indicators.note: third of picks out the third letter of the 21 down answer

explanation.surface: A goddess is arranging two letters of another answer in sequence.
explanation.walkthrough: The second and third letters of MAENADS, put in order, are A then E.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek goddess of wisdom, also spelt Athena.

clue.text: Wonderful goddess hiding in wood

indicators.note: a goddess hiding in wood is put inside the tree word

parts.note: fir is a softwood timber
Vesta is the Roman goddess of the hearth

explanation.surface: A marvellous goddess is concealing herself in a forest.
explanation.definitionFit: Five-star is the top hotel rating, hence excellent or superb.

clue.text: Goddess concealing second of beauty spots

indicators.note: concealing means the goddess hides the letter inside her name

parts.note: Venus is the Roman goddess of love and beauty

indicators.note: second of signals only the second letter of the word beauty

explanation.surface: The goddess of love conceals her blemishes from the beauty spots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spots' looks tied to 'beauty spots' but is the definition alone, meaning places.
explanation.definitionFit: Spots in the sense of places or locations are venues where events happen.

clue.text: I won't ever remove lid from inverted can!

indicators.note: inverted in a down clue means turned upside down, so the remaining letters read upwards
removing the lid takes off the top, the first letter

parts.note: the can is slang for prison

explanation.surface: Someone refuses ever to take the lid off an upside-down can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remove lid from' cuts PRISON to RISON, and 'inverted' turns it around.
explanation.definitionFit: No sir is an emphatic refusal, the reply of someone who will not do it.

clue.text: Chaotic form disowned, happy to come first

indicators.note: to come first puts the happy word before the rearranged letters

parts.note: up means cheerful, in high spirits

indicators.note: to form is to shape, so the letters of disowned are reshaped

explanation.surface: A disowned form leaves someone glad to be first in line amid chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' rearranges DISOWNED to SIDEDOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Upside down means in total disorder, so it describes a chaotic state.

clue.text: Reach god by bus, finally

indicators.note: finally signals the final letter of the word bus

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of shepherds and the wild

explanation.surface: You get to the god in the end by taking the bus.
explanation.definitionFit: Span as a noun means extent or range, the reach of something.

clue.text: 'We have arrived', daughter announced

parts.note: on arrival you might announce 'us here!', meaning we have arrived

explanation.surface: A daughter declares that the family has arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: 'announced' looks like a sound signal but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An usher announces guests as he shows them in, so ushered can mean introduced or heralded.

clue.text: Most immediate gain overwhelming god

indicators.note: overwhelming means the gain word engulfs the god, holding him inside

parts.note: to net is to gain, as with profit
Ares is the Greek god of war

explanation.surface: An immediate gain overpowers a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: The nearest thing is the closest one, so the most immediate in place or time.
